geography_note: No parcel address, APN, owner identity, rent, basis or loan term is stored anywhere in this session. Every figure below is city-, county-, metro-, state- or national-level.

tiers.A: U.S. federal or California state / local government primary source read directly by this session on the access date.
tiers.B: SEC EDGAR filing data for the tenant, read from the Commission's own XBRL and filing indexes.
tiers.C: Company or trade source. Never used for a 'verified' government statistic.

sources.publisher: City of Los Angeles Office of Finance
sources.title: Real Property Transfer Tax and Measure ULA FAQ
sources.note: Current thresholds confirmed: $5,400,000 and $10,900,000 for transactions closing after June 30, 2026; base rate $2.25 per $500.

sources.title: Documentary Transfer Tax
sources.note: County rate $0.55 per $500; the five 'special' cities including Los Angeles are taxed at the full $1.10 per $1,000. Also confirms the City of Los Angeles schedule effective 7/1/26.

sources.title: Real Property Assessment - An Overview of Property Taxes / Proposition 13
sources.note: 1% maximum levy, 2% annual cap, reassessment at change of ownership or completed new construction.

sources.title: Instructions for Form 8824, Like-Kind Exchanges (2025)
sources.note: Confirms the exchange is limited to real property and describes deferred-exchange safe harbors.

sources.title: 2025 California Tax Rate Schedules (Form 540)
sources.note: Top marginal bracket shown on the schedules is 12.30%. The additional 1% Mental Health Services Tax above $1,000,000 of taxable income is not printed on the 540 schedules and is therefore NOT asserted as verified here.
